content:
# CMU firmware profiles. Compatibility is data: bench findings (for example, closing
# the 59-vs-70 gap) land here and in each tweak's `compat` list, not as code branches.
#
# status:
#   target    a unit we own and build for
#   untested  newer than anything upstream tested; refused unless the config allows it
#   legacy    upstream supported it; this rewrite has not looked at it; refused
#   blocked   known brick risk; always refused
#
# A version outside every profile, or with a middle field other than 00 (a
# development build), is treated as blocked.
#
# A profile matches major_min..=major (major_min defaults to major) and
# patch_min..=patch_max of the version "MAJOR.00.PATCH".

[[profile]]
id = "v70-00x"
label = "70.00.000 - 70.00.360"
major = 70
patch_min = 0
patch_max = 360
status = "target"
first_access = "serial-autorun"
backup = { strategy = "dir", dir = "/tmp/mnt/resources/dev/mzd-tweaks/backup" }
rootfs_reserve_kib = 4096
rootfs_tight = true
units = ["CMU 2: TA0A 66 9C0 A, 70.00.352B (2020)"]
notes = [
  "Upstream tested through 70.00.352.",
  "rootfs ships nearly full; filling it soft-bricks the unit, so backups go to the resources partition.",
  "The USB data-retrieval unlock is closed; first access is over serial to install an autorun hook.",
]

[[profile]]
id = "v59-5xx"
label = "59.00.500 - 59.00.599"
major = 59
patch_min = 500
patch_max = 599
status = "target"
first_access = "serial-autorun"
backup = { strategy = "sibling" }
rootfs_reserve_kib = 2048
rootfs_tight = false
units = ["CMU 1: KB7W 66 9C0 F, 59.00.540 (sticker 59.00.544), on the shelf"]
notes = [
  "59.00.502+ closed the USB data-retrieval unlock; first access is over serial.",
  "Upstream's USB Audio Mod and media-order patches do not support 59.00.502+.",
]

[[profile]]
id = "v70-361plus"
label = "70.00.361 and newer"
major = 70
patch_min = 361
patch_max = 999
status = "untested"
first_access = "serial-autorun"
backup = { strategy = "dir", dir = "/tmp/mnt/resources/dev/mzd-tweaks/backup" }
rootfs_reserve_kib = 4096
rootfs_tight = true
units = []
notes = ["Newer than anything upstream tested."]
